name: finance-provision-tools
description: Indira IVF finance - monthly provision workings (Security, Housekeeping, ...). One self-contained offline HTML page per provision.

scripts.test: npm run test:release && npm run test:security && npm run test:core && npm run test:hk-expenses && npm run test:hk-material
scripts.test:security: npm run test:security:tagger && npm run test:security:scenarios && npm run test:security:sep && npm run test:security:golden
scripts.test:security:scenarios: node test/security/run.js test-data/extract_Sep-26.xlsx test-data/statement_Aug-26.xlsx test-data/provision_Sep-26.xlsx out/sep26.xlsx "{\"openingYtdCol\":\"M\"}" && node test/security/scenarios.js test-data out/sep26.xlsx
scripts.test:security:sep: node test/security/run.js test-data/extract_Sep-26.xlsx test-data/statement_Aug-26.xlsx test-data/provision_Sep-26.xlsx out/sep26.xlsx "{\"openingYtdCol\":\"M\"}" && node test/security/compare_sep.js out/sep26.xlsx test-data/finance_statement_Sep-26.xlsx
scripts.test:security:golden: node test/security/golden_run.js src/security/engine.js test-data/extract_Sep-26.xlsx test-data/statement_Aug-26.xlsx test-data/provision_Sep-26.xlsx out/golden_sep26.xlsx "{\"openingYtdCol\":\"M\"}" && node test/golden.js test-data/golden/security_sep26.xlsx out/golden_sep26.xlsx
scripts.test:security:e2e: node test/security/e2e.js security.html test-data/extract_Sep-26.xlsx test-data/statement_Aug-26.xlsx test-data/provision_Sep-26.xlsx out/e2e_sep26.xlsx out/e2e && node test/golden.js test-data/golden/security_sep26.xlsx out/e2e_sep26.xlsx
scripts.test:core: node test/core/tagger_parity.js && node test/core/tagger_hk.js && node test/core/security_parity.js
scripts.test:e2e: npm run test:security:e2e && npm run test:hk-expenses:e2e && npm run test:hk-material:e2e && npm run test:start:e2e
